notes.title: February Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
[h1]New and Tweaked Systems[/h1]
[list]
[*] Can now Load saved games from the main menu. Please note that all old save files are no longer compatible with this new upgrade.
[*] Added tutorials into the escape menu, allowing you to reread them if necessary.
[*] Can get to the main menu from the escape menu and game over screens.
[*] Camera starts the game over your starting region.
[*] Blueprints can be given have the player input custom names.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a camera issue to allow better rotation around the poles.
[*] Blueprints button now correctly activates when blueprints can be designed.
[*] Factory construct button activates when factories are actually available for construction.
[*] Research system saving and loading should be improved.
[*] Pop-ups will no longer allow you to construct something that will bankrupt you.
[*] Saving and loading is faster and will not break.
[*] Can no longer create the same blueprint twice.
[*] Truck blockages should be resolved.
[*] Can no longer build a second building on your starting tile.
[*] Dropdown menus no longer sometimes get confused with what information they should output.
[/list]

notes.title: First Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
[h2]New and Tweaked Systems[/h2]
[h3]Updating Main Menu Choices[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now when you start a new game you no longer choose between starting with a small grain farm or a small metal mine but instead are given a starting resource building based on whichever region you select.
[*]Main Menu interface updated to more clearly display selected region.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Issues with loading a previously saved game should now be resolved and no longer crash the game.
[*]When you research components you can now build a factory to build said components, without having researched more processed goods that require blueprints.
[*]Save warning, load warning, quit warning and volume control no longer remains turned on when reopening the escape menu.
[*]Loading the game no longer relocks items that have been previously researched.
[*]Constructing buildings and vehicles will no longer occasionally charge you a second time.
[/list]
